title: Longest Subarray With Restricted Pair Sums
statement: Given an array of up to 1000 integers valued 1 to 500, the problem asks for the longest subarray in which no element equals the sum of two others at distinct indices. Validity is inherited by sub-subarrays, so a sliding window works: when a value enters, scan the small value range with frequency counts for a triple involving it and shrink until none remains; extending from every start also passes.
